name: nilovelez/cute-wp-badges
description: Development tools for Cute WP Badges. Not part of the plugin package.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks the PHP code against the WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Fixes what can be fixed automatically in the PHP code.
scripts-descriptions.update-badges: Updates the badge catalog and icons from WordPress.org, then validates them.
scripts-descriptions.validate-badges: Checks the badge catalog and rebuilds preview.html.
